Post-hoc Adjustments of cell classifications

Source: R/adjust_classification.R
adjust_classification.Rd

The function adds adjusted classifications and diagnostic measures to the data.frame stored in flexmix_data and adds thresholds and the number of reassigned cells in flexmix_list[["adjustment_method"]].

Usage

adjust_classification(
  flexmix_list,
  adjustment_method = c("original_check", "geometry_check"),
  min_index_type = "all",
  enforce_left_cutoff = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

flexmix_list

The list object returned by run_miQCadj() with required flexmix_data and model_info slots.

adjustment_method

Character Scalar or Vector. Available options include original_check performing the original miQC filtering adjustments with keep_all_below_boundary=TRUE and geometry_check performing the modified geometry check using the default parameters with rescue_quantile = 0.5, discard_quantile = 0.95, converge_quantile = 0.05,safe_keep_dist = 1.25. For further adjustments the specific functions should be used. By default both checks will be performed.

min_index_type

Character Scalar. The minimum of mitochondrial percentage within discarded cells. Whether all cells should be checked for this minimum min_index_type = "all" or whether to restrict the check to discarded cells min_index_type = "discard". Since the original wrapper used all cells, the default is "all".

enforce_left_cutoff

Logical Scalar. Whether cells with low library complexity and cells with high mitochondrial percentage should be discarded. Will only be used, if adjustment_method = original_check. Defaults to TRUE.

verbose

Logical Scalar. Whether information regarding reassignments should be printed. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

flexmix_list with updated slot information for:

flexmix_data

Updated data frame with adjustment results.

adjustment_method

Method-specific adjustment information.

See also

original_adjustments(), geometry_adjustments()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# run both geometry checks
flexmix_list <- adjust_classification(flexmix_list)
} # }
